thread:
lela-docs: Quick heads-up — opened a small PR to clarify how tier credits are aggregated across orgs/projects and to add an SDK snippet for the new billing header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4127
sanjay-eng: thanks! gonna skim. any TL;DR on what breaks for customers?
lela-docs: TL;DR — credits are summed at the org level by default. The doc now shows how to request per-project breakouts for analytics using the `X-Redwood-Usage-Scope` header. Also fixed a dashboard panel that was double-counting tokens for multi-sku customers.
mike-backend: can you paste the header example? want to ensure server parsing matches.
lela-docs: sure — inline curl example added: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"X-Redwood-Usage-Scope: project:abc\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
anna-analytics: the dashboard change looks right but the PromQL needs a slight tweak — currently uses `sum by (org,project) (rate(usage_tokens[5m]))`. For multi-sku reports we should do `sum by (org,project,sku) (rate(usage_tokens_total[5m]))`. I left a note in the PR.
sanjay-eng: also add a short SDK example (python/node) showing how to set the header; a lot of customers ask for that.
lela-docs: added both snippets in the PR. python:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token=TOKEN)
client.headers.update({"X-Redwood-Usage-Scope": "project:abc"})
res = client.generate("Summarize this...")
```

node:

```js
const Redwood = require('redwood');
const client = new Redwood({ token: TOKEN });
client.setHeader('X-Redwood-Usage-Scope', 'project:abc');
await client.text.generate({ prompt: 'Summarize this...' });
```

mike-backend: looks good. one nit: add one sentence clarifying that the header is for analytics/scope only and does not change org-level billing decisions (billing still sums credits at the org unless an enterprise billing override exists).
lela-docs: added that sentence + a small callout box. Also added a short migration note for customers using the old `X-Usage-Segment` header (we're deprecating it).
deploy-bot: Deployment queued for branch docs/tier-credit-fixup — CI: https://ci.redwood/1234/status
anna-analytics: approved the wording and PromQL tweak. left a tiny nits comment about panel labels.
sanjay-eng: i'll do the API spec check and push a tiny alignment commit today (add the header to the openapi examples).
lela-docs: thanks — i'll wait for that before merging. If folks want to sanity-check locally, run `make docs-serve` and open /billing/usage. Quick smoke test: call the api with `X-Redwood-Usage-Scope: project:test` and confirm the analytics view shows the project dimension.
mike-backend: i'll run e2e tomorrow; ping me if the CI flaps :thumbsup:
